subject: Q2 hiring allocation — committee decisions and next steps
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com, dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Cc: talent@glcapital.com
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hiring allocation committee — Q2 headcount proposals & decisions needed

Team —

Ahead of the QBR next week I pulled together an updated Q2 headcount proposal (attached) and a short recommendation column where I tried to prioritize based on revenue-impact and operational risk. High level: we have capacity for +9 hires vs. baseline budget, but we should treat ~3 of those as backfills/critical maintenance and 6 as discretionary.

Key asks:
- Please review the attached Q2_headcount_proposal.xlsx and add a single-cell decision (Approve / Hold / Reprioritize) in the "Committee Decision" column for each row by EOD Tuesday (tomorrow).
- I need final language for the QBR slide deck by Wednesday morning. If we don't reach consensus, I'll present a conservative plan (approve backfills + 2 discretionary hires).
- If you see a candidate to move to contractor for shorter runway, mark it in the comments.

Quick context highlights:
- Dedicated infra (2 ICs, 1 senior engineer) requested to support the new Dedicated cluster rollout — delaying these increases risk to throughput SLAs for customers under reserved capacity.
- Product & UX: 1 PM and 1 Senior UX (requested) to support an embeddable SDK initiative; high upside, but can be deprioritized if infra is critical.
- Sales/CS Ops: 2 headcount asks tied to enterprise GTM capacity; these are time-sensitive for renewal coverage.

Attachments: Q2_headcount_proposal.xlsx (xls, 92KB)
Drive: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Q2HeadcountProposal

Connor
Connor O'Brien
Director, Finance & Planning — Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.com, dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hiring allocation committee — Q2 headcount proposals & decisions needed

Connor —

Thanks for the clear deck. I ran the numbers against the quarterly budget and spoke briefly with Ops about the Dedicated rollout risk. My read:

- Approve as-is: 2 infra ICs (critical backfills), 1 CS Ops hire (renewal coverage)
- Hold: Senior UX (move to timeline Q3 unless we see strong early evidence)
- Reprioritize: PM role — mark as "contractor first"; we can re-evaluate in 6-8 weeks if the SDK initiative shows signal

I've attached a quick approval_matrix.pdf with the cells filled and a short note on budget headroom. This keeps us within the +9 headcount envelope while protecting SLAs.

Attachment: approval_matrix.pdf (pdf, 48KB)

Laura Bennett
VP, Product — Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hiring allocation committee — Q2 hiring decisions (infra priority)

Laura / Connor —

I appreciate the matrix. Two counterpoints from infra:

1) If we delay the senior infra engineer we will have to throttle Dedicated cluster rollout by ~6 weeks; that has a direct revenue impact for committed customers on Dedicated (we have two customers scheduled for onboarding in late Q2).
2) The PM contractor suggestion is reasonable, but replacing the PM hire with a senior infra engineer + one infra IC (swap the discretionary PM for infra) gives better expected ROI given current pipeline.

Proposal: Approve 3 infra hires (senior infra + 2 ICs) as priority; move PM to contractor for 12 weeks; hold Senior UX. I'll attach a short note outlining the technical risks and a link to the Jira ticket that tracks resource gating for the rollout.

Attachment: infra_impact_notes.docx (docx, 28KB)
Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/HR-4821

Markus Klein
Head of Infrastructure Engineering — Redwood Inference

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>

Subject: Final decision: Q2 hires (committee consensus) + action items

Thanks all — good discussion. Per committee consensus and budget guardrails, final decisions: 

- Approve immediately (to proceed with requisitions and offers): Senior Infra Engineer, 2 Infra ICs, 1 CS Ops hire (4 hires total; these are a mix of backfills + prioritized additions).
- Move to contractor: Product PM (12-week contractor engagement to validate SDK product-market fit).
- Hold / defer: Senior UX (shift to Q3 reprioritization).

Action items:
- Dylan: open CS Ops req and start candidate outreach (work with Greenleaf Capital for contractor sourcing where helpful).
- Markus: open infra reqs in Lever; tag hires with HR-4821 and add org-level start dates in the Jira ticket.
- Laura: update QBR slide language and submit final deck tonight (I will include the headcount slide).
- Recruiting / Talent (CC'd): please queue offers for approved roles; Connor will review budgets and approve salary bands before sending.

Related links: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Q2HeadcountProposal, https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/HR-4821
Note: Recruiting, please confirm ETA for offer packages by EOD Monday so we can keep onboarding timelines intact.

Connor
